# crosswork_aaa_session_settings (Resource)

This resource can manage the AAA settings.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_aaa_session_settings" "example" {
  fallback_type              = "FB_ON_NO_RESPONSE"
  idle_session_timeout       = 60
  parallel_sessions          = 100
  parallel_sessions_per_user = 100
  source_ip_auditing         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `fallback_type` (String) When users who are not in the remote servers may fall back to local authentication
  - Choices: `NO_FALLBACK`, `FB_ON_NO_RESPONSE`, `FB_ON_NORESP_AUTH_FAILURE`
  - Default value: `FB_ON_NORESP_AUTH_FAILURE`
- `idle_session_timeout` (Number) Minutes after which an idle browser session is logged out
  - Default value: `30`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `parallel_sessions` (Number) Number of parallel sessions of the cluster
  - Default value: `100`
- `parallel_sessions_per_user` (Number) Number of parallel sessions of one user
  - Default value: `100`
- `source_ip_auditing` (Boolean) Record the source IP address of users for auditing
  - Default value: `false`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_aaa_session_settings.example "aaa_session_settings"
```
